jobs.description:
THE POSITION

Do you have a passion to help others, especially the older Pennsylvania population? If so, the Monroe County Area Agency on Aging would like to talk to you! As an Aging Care Manager 3, y ou will work in a role that encourages growth, learning, and community connection. Each day brings new opportunities to make a difference through collaboration and direct support. Your commitment to service will help create meaningful outcomes for those who need it most.

DESCRIPTION OF WORK

This position plays a key role in supporting older adults by identifying needs, arranging services, and ensuring timely intervention. The work focuses on helping individuals access resources that improve safety, health, and independence. As an Aging Care Manager 3, you will perform the following duties:

Case Reviews: Review categories of need and begin investigations within required time frames according to regulations of the Older Adults Protective Services Act
Risk Reduction: Reduce or mitigate risk to older adults and complete investigations within regulated timelines
Service Planning: Develop care plans, complete assessments, and document contacts using the SAMS program
Resource Coordination: Arrange medical, psychological, and social assessments and connect individuals with appropriate services
Community Outreach: Provide education on protective services and mandatory reporting through public presentations
Team Collaboration: Meet with supervisors, attend network meetings, and assist with related task force activities

Job Summary

The Research Data Analyst will work under the direction of the Principal Investigator to support collaborative research integrating genomic and multi-omic data with clinical and electronic health record (EHR) data. The analyst will contribute to projects investigating the genetic, epigenetic, and downstream molecular basis of psychiatric and related complex traits.

Does this position require Patient Care?

No

Essential Functions

Perform statistical analyses of genomic and molecular data, including polygenic risk score (PRS) analyses and association testing.
Integrate genetic, transcriptomic, methylomic, clinical, and EHR phenotype data to investigate relationships between molecular variation and clinical outcomes.
Analyze high-dimensional transcriptomic and DNA methylation datasets.
Train genetically regulated gene expression (GReX) models and conduct transcriptome-wide association studies (TWAS).
Perform differential expression and association analyses using statistical frameworks such as limma and related R/Bioconductor tools.
Organize, curate, and analyze clinical and EHR-derived phenotype data, including data collection, harmonization, quality control, and phenotype definition.
Develop and maintain reproducible analysis pipelines in R and/or Python.
Conduct data quality control, visualization, statistical modeling, and interpretation of results.
Organize, document, and maintain research datasets and analysis outputs to facilitate reproducibility and collaboration.
Work closely with investigators on study design, analysis, interpretation, and preparation of results for presentations and manuscripts.

Education

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in bioinformatics, biostatistics, computational biology, data science, statistics, genetics/genomics, or a related quantitative field required.

Yes

Proficiency in R and statistical data analysis; experience with Python is desirable.
Experience working with large, complex, or high-dimensional biomedical datasets.
Familiarity with genomic, transcriptomic, DNA methylation, or other molecular data.
